name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
candidate:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  change (extractOldExprVars post).Subset (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars post)
  have ap {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h : a.Subset b) (k : c.Subset d) :=
    List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ k)
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => exact fun _ => nofun
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ iht ihe => exact ap iht ihe
  | ite _ _ _ ihc iht ihe => exact ap (ap ihc iht) ihe
  | eq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ap ih₁ ih₂
  | app _ _ hn ihf ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
    · next hf =>
      cases hn .oldPred
      exact (hf _ _ _ rfl).elim
    · exact ap ihf ihe
